title: P16-ARCH-01 path-scoped implementation
goal: Implement only the behavior defined by specification.md, limiting any future changes to the fixture implementation and its focused test.

acceptance_criteria.text: Any implementation change is confined to implementation.ts.
Any test change is confined to focused.test.ts.
specification.md remains unchanged and is used only as read-only requirements context.
No files outside the two explicitly allowed paths are created, modified, renamed, or deleted.

recommendation_reasons: The fixture exposes only three small, explicitly bounded files.
Safe scope can be expressed with exact-file allow rules.
No repository-wide investigation or architectural change is authorized.
